title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveil LLM-optimized inference chip
summary: OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.
body: OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.
summaryZh: OpenAI与博通（Broadcom）共同揭晓了名为Jalapeño的定制化AI推理芯片。该芯片专为大模型推理工作负载设计，旨在显著提升AI系统的运行性能、能效比以及扩展规模。原始信息显示：OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI and Broadcom unveil LLM-optimized inference chip”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与博通联合发布了专为大模型推理优化的定制AI芯片Jalapeño。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
